commit.message:
ci: improve container build - skip if tag exists, no intermediate registry pushes

- Add check-tag job that queries Docker Hub and GHCR for the tag in
  bin/.container-tag; if the tag already exists in both registries the
  build and merge jobs are skipped entirely.
- Remove push-by-digest registry uploads from the per-platform build
  jobs. Each platform now builds locally and exports to a tarball that
  is uploaded as a GitHub Actions artifact (image-amd64 / image-arm64).
  Nothing is pushed to any registry during the build phase.
- The merge job downloads both tarballs, loads them, retaggs with
  platform suffixes, pushes those platform images, then assembles the
  final multi-platform manifest with the versioned tag via
  docker buildx imagetools create. Only the final tagged manifest
  and its platform-specific backing images land in the registry.
